SELECT * FROM ( SELECT o.order_no AS orderNo, o.member_no AS memberNo, o.orderer_name AS ordererName, o.total_price AS totalPrice, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.created_at AS createdAt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY o.created_at DESC) AS rn FROM orders o WHERE member_no = #{memberNo} ) WHERE rn >= #{startRow} AND rn <= #{endRow}

SELECT oi.order_item_no AS orderItemNo, oi.order_no AS orderNo, oi.product_option_no AS productOptionNo, po.product_no AS productNo, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.unit_price AS unitPrice, oi.item_name AS itemName, oi.item_size AS itemSize, oi.item_color AS itemColor, pi.image_url AS imageUrl, oi.order_item_status AS orderItemStatus FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN product_option po ON oi.product_option_no = po.product_option_no LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON po.product_no = pi.product_no AND pi.image_type = 'THUMB' WHERE oi.order_no = #{orderNo}
